title: Veterans' Compensation Cost-of-Living Adjustment Act of 2014
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Veterans' Compensation Cost-of-Living Adjustment Act of 2014 - Directs the Secretary of Veterans Affairs (VA) to increase, as of December 1, 2014, the rates of veterans' disability compensation, additional compensation for dependents, the clothing allowance for certain disabled veterans, and dependency and indemnity compensation for surviving spouses and children.

Requires each such increase to be the same percentage as the increase in benefits provided under title II (Old Age, Survivors and Disability Insurance) of the Social Security Act, on the same effective date.

summary.headline: This law requires VA to raise certain veterans' disability and survivor benefits starting December 1, 2014, by the same percentage as the Social Security benefit increase.
summary.what_it_does: It directs the Secretary of Veterans Affairs to increase several monthly payments to veterans and their families. The payments include disability compensation, extra pay for dependents, the clothing allowance for certain disabled veterans, and dependency and indemnity compensation for surviving spouses and children. Each increase matches the percentage increase in Social Security benefits under Title II and takes effect on the same date.

who_it_affects.how: Their monthly disability payments rise by the same percentage as Social Security benefits starting December 1, 2014.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans with dependents receiving additional compensation
who_it_affects.how: The extra amounts paid for their dependents increase by the same Social Security percentage.

who_it_affects.group: Certain disabled veterans receiving the clothing allowance
who_it_affects.how: The clothing allowance they receive increases by the same Social Security percentage.

who_it_affects.group: Surviving spouses receiving dependency and indemnity compensation
who_it_affects.how: Their survivor payments rise by the same Social Security percentage.

who_it_affects.group: Surviving children receiving dependency and indemnity compensation
who_it_affects.how: Their survivor payments rise by the same Social Security percentage.
